request: Remove the active tab panel entrance fade and replace it with animation on tab switching itself.

decisions.tabSwitch: Transition existing active-tab background, border, label color, and blue inset box-shadow accents over 180ms ease-out.
decisions.panelContent: No entrance animation; newly selected panel content appears immediately as before.
decisions.otherMotion: Retain the TASK-054 window/menu/tooltip and button/form transitions and native tree timings unchanged.
decisions.focusAndPressed: Keep focus and pressed feedback immediate.
decisions.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion disables CSS transitions and fades; native tree override remains unchanged.

scope: Theme package only. No app descriptor, WGR source, parent theme, or SDK changes.
geometry: The tab animation interpolates paint-only properties; it does not move or resize tabs, panels, or contents.
preview: The user directly requested this change after reviewing the prior motion demo.
